$source.note: Figma effect styles are not variables, so they are captured here by hand. Colors are fixed across modes in Figma. Hidden effects are omitted. shadow/input-failed is a local (unnamed) effect on Input State=Failed in Style=Default and Soft, not an effect style. shadows/modal-sm also has a 1 px ring bound to border/default; the ring is composed in the component CSS (it follows the colour scheme).
